split_rule: all target timestamps contained in one split; preceding history allowed
cell_metric: micro over all origins, H steps and zones
macro_metric: equal mean of 24 fold-horizon cell metrics per seed; report seed mean and SD
selection: validation clipped RMSE; patience 5, maximum 30 epochs in screening
screening_limit: one H3 smoke; route gate uses fold1 H3 and H12, regularization grid 0.001/0.01/0.1; deterministic convex heads are not seed replicates
foundation_model_point_policy: Identify native mean and median semantics before evaluation; no unlabelled sparse-quantile average
checkpoint_freeze: configuration, code hash and training-validation prefix hash
